result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. I found a typo in the search placeholder and a duration pill that overlaps its card image. The clipped carousel items and the partly visible pizza card are expected behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The search placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries'. 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' cards, the time pills (e.g. '15–25 min') sit on the bottom-left edge of the image and overlap the plate illustration. On the first card, the pill also extends slightly beyond the image's rounded corner area. They look inconsistent with the card padding.
issues.suggestion: Give the pills consistent inset padding from the card edges and keep them clear of the key image content.

issues.description: The gray secondary text (delivery fees, '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') and the placeholder text are light gray on white or light gray. Contrast is low, and the small size makes them harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast of 4.5:1.
